property.description: End native date.

property.label: End native datetime
property.description: End native datetime.

property.name: endTime
property.label: End local time
property.description: Optional clock with a native end date.

property.name: operatingHoursId
property.label: OperatingHours ID
property.description: Use one saved ID or a supplied OperatingHours record.

property.name: operatingHours
property.label: OperatingHours record
property.description: A supplied record can be unsaved. Also supply its TimeSlot and Holiday collections.

property.name: timeSlots
property.label: Time slots
property.description: Normal slots for the supplied schedule; no DML is performed.

property.name: holidays
property.label: Holidays
property.description: Holiday records for the supplied schedule, including recurring holidays.

property.name: otherOperatingHoursIds
property.label: Additional schedule IDs
property.description: Saved schedule IDs to intersect or unite with the primary schedule.

property.name: scheduleCombination
property.label: Combine schedules
property.description: Combine schedules.

property.name: busyRanges
property.label: Busy intervals
property.description: ISO exact start/end intervals to exclude from availability.

property.name: busyRangesText
property.label: Fixed busy intervals
property.description: One exact ISO start/end interval per line.

property.name: duration
property.label: Continuous duration
property.description: Positive elapsed ISO duration, for example PT30M. Calendar units are not appointment lengths.

property.name: stepDuration
property.label: Appointment start interval
property.description: Positive elapsed ISO duration. Defaults to the appointment duration. Starts are anchored to each open window.

property.name: maximumResults
property.label: Maximum results
property.description: 1–1000, default 100. Exceeding it returns an error.

property.name: referenceInstant
property.label: Reference datetime
property.description: Required when notice or booking horizon is set; use a Flow datetime such as the current datetime.

property.name: minimumNotice
property.label: Minimum notice
property.description: Non-negative elapsed ISO duration from the reference datetime, for example PT2H.

property.name: bookingHorizon
property.label: Booking horizon
property.description: Positive elapsed ISO duration from the reference datetime; the complete appointment must fit before this limit.

property.name: bufferBefore
property.label: Buffer before
property.description: Non-negative elapsed duration kept free before each appointment within operating hours.

property.name: bufferAfter
property.label: Buffer after
property.description: Non-negative elapsed duration kept free after each appointment within operating hours.

property.name: gridAnchor
property.label: Appointment grid anchor
property.description: Optional exact datetime anchoring appointment starts across all windows and busy breaks. Without it each free window anchors its own grid.
